master_placement.note: App semantics: scale = design width as a fraction of the product photo width. 0.32 reproduces the Oregon mockup look (badge about 31% of image width, centred chest). This is the default Srity can adjust; it is NOT a copy of Printify's scale numbers, which are relative to the print area, not the photo.
